name: Archangel: Demon Rush
description:
About This Game

BUILD THE FORTRESS. BECOME THE WEAPON.

In Archangel: Demon Rush, building and fighting happen at the same time.

Place turrets, shape the battlefield and reinforce your defences while relentless hordes are already attacking. When the line begins to break, step into the slaughter yourself and fight beside your fortress.

You are not watching the battle from a distance.

You fight inside the war machine you create.

BUILD WHILE THEY ATTACK

There is no quiet preparation phase.

Demons are already advancing towards your objective while you place defences, reinforce key positions and react to the pressure of the battlefield. Every decision matters, because every second of preparation happens under threat.

Hold the line, adapt your layout and keep building while the siege is already in motion.

FIGHT INSIDE YOUR OWN FORTRESS

Your turrets can weaken the horde, control routes and create deadly kill zones—but they cannot win alone.

When enemies break through, you must enter the battlefield yourself. Use brutal melee weapons, firearms and powerful abilities to destroy anything your defences cannot stop.

Your fortress needs you.

TURN A DESPERATE DEFENCE INTO A WAR MACHINE

Each run begins as a struggle for survival.

As the siege escalates, you will unlock stronger upgrades, combine weapons with defences, stack cards and passive effects, and discover synergies that transform the battlefield into a storm of steel, fire, blood and divine destruction.

What begins as a fragile defence can end as a screen-filling massacre.

CREATE A DIFFERENT BUILD EVERY RUN

Experiment with freely placed defences, offensive abilities, weapon upgrades and powerful combinations that change the way each siege plays out.

Build around crowd control, raw damage, layered defences, aggressive melee combat or hybrid strategies in which every part of your fortress supports another.

Every run is another opportunity to build something stronger, deadlier and more satisfying.

SURVIVE A FULL-SCALE SIEGE

This is not a short skirmish.

Every run is a complete battle that escalates from early pressure into overwhelming chaos. Enemies grow stronger, the battlefield becomes harder to control and your build must evolve quickly enough to survive the final waves.

Start surrounded. End unstoppable.

FEATURES

  • Build and upgrade your defences while the battle is already happening.

  • Fight beside your fortress in brutal third-person combat.

  • Place your defences freely—without a restrictive grid.

  • Combine turrets, weapons, cards and abilities into devastating synergies.

  • Survive escalating hordes of demons in full-scale siege battles.

  • Adapt your strategy in real time as enemies break through your lines.

  • Create different builds and strategies every run.

  • Transform a desperate defence into an unstoppable machine of destruction.
short_desc: Build your fortress while the horde is already attacking, then fight inside it. Freely place turrets and combine brutal weapons, cards and abilities until a desperate defence becomes an unstoppable demon-killing war machine in this third-person action roguelite.
